correctness.rationale: For every two nonzero elements a∈H,b∈K, u=a⊕2b and v=a⊕b are linearly independent: u=λv would require λ=1 and λ=2. Yet the Ghosh–Samanta componentwise sum is [a,a|a]+[2b,2b|b]=0 by component dependence, violating the 2-inner-product iff-dependence axiom. Thus a purported universal n≥2 n-Hilbert direct sum fails already n=2. The conventional Hilbert-induced 2-inner product on H⊕K has Gram-determinant cross terms omitted in that formula. This disproves the ambient-geometry claim; it does not by itself re-prove any corrected frame theorem.
